changes: Implemented the Story 3 finding-ledger and runtime-evidence integrity foundation: append-only fenced atomic persistence, exact CAS and idempotency receipts, signed lifecycle projection, content-addressed runtime evidence, historical re-attestation, process-fact registration, and proof-or-stop package/CLI binding.
usage: Use the repository-local CLI for an unmerged Story, for example: node packages/main/dist/cli.js finding_ledger_query --storyId=B-fe8f. Runtime evidence uses the registered finding_runtime_evidence_run and finding_runtime_evidence_verify commands.
expectedOutcome: The RED audit prints red.audit_summary with the historical pre-fix SHA, reports only proven contract gaps, and after implementation reports gaps=0 with no genuine contract failure.
actualTranscript: The live command node packages/main/tests/red/red-bfe8f-ledger-runtime-integrity.mjs exited 0, printed red.audit_summary with preFixHead 0cb578583b5139977338d1cf8f7aeed0cc7685ba, gaps=0, every RED relation check PASS, and red.genuine_contract_failure:none.
outcomeDiff: No acceptance difference: the actual transcript matched the expected audit contract and showed no remaining genuine Story 3 gap.
limitations: Before the Story merges, the global proof-or-stop binary intentionally reflects current main and cannot expose unmerged worktree commands; use the repository-local CLI inside the Story worktree. The difference disappears after DONE merges the Story to main.
pitfalls: The full validation suite is long and earlier attempts hit timeout or concurrency noise; the final official run passed 125/125 and was reused because materialHash and storyFilesHash stayed unchanged. Global and worktree CLIs share a version string, so verify realpath and use node packages/main/dist/cli.js for branch-local behavior.
